with ranked_events as (
    select
        *,
        row_number() over (
            partition by game_id, event_number
            order by
                (home_description is not null
                    or neutral_description is not null
                    or away_description is not null) desc,
                (score_text is not null) desc,
                event_type_id nulls last,
                event_action_type_id nulls last
        ) as duplicate_rank
    from BASKETBALL_DEV.staging.stg_play_by_play
)
select
    game_id,
    event_number,
    event_type_id,
    event_action_type_id,
    case event_type_id
        when 1 then 'MADE_SHOT'
        when 2 then 'MISSED_SHOT'
        when 3 then 'FREE_THROW'
        when 4 then 'REBOUND'
        when 5 then 'TURNOVER'
        when 6 then 'FOUL'
        when 7 then 'VIOLATION'
        when 8 then 'SUBSTITUTION'
        when 9 then 'TIMEOUT'
        when 10 then 'JUMP_BALL'
        when 12 then 'PERIOD_END'
        when 13 then 'GAME_END'
        else 'OTHER'
    end as event_category,
    period_number,
    game_clock,
    period_clock,
    home_description,
    neutral_description,
    away_description,
    score_text,
    score_margin,
    player1_id,
    player1_name,
    player1_team_id,
    player2_id,
    player2_name,
    player2_team_id,
    player3_id,
    player3_name,
    player3_team_id,
    video_available
from ranked_events
where duplicate_rank = 1

with combine as (
    select *
    from BASKETBALL_DEV.staging.stg_draft_combine_stats
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by player_id, draft_year
        order by (height_no_shoes_inches is not null) desc,
                 (wingspan_inches is not null) desc
    ) = 1
)
select
    c.*,
    p.full_name as canonical_player_name
from combine as c
left join BASKETBALL_DEV.staging.stg_player as p
    on c.player_id = p.player_id

select distinct
    md5(
        'NBA_TEAM_HISTORY:' || cast(team_id as varchar) || ':' ||
        coalesce(cast(valid_from_year as varchar), '') || ':' ||
        coalesce(cast(valid_to_year as varchar), '') || ':' ||
        coalesce(team_city, '') || ':' || coalesce(team_nickname, '')
    ) as team_history_key,
    team_id,
    team_city,
    team_nickname,
    valid_from_year,
    valid_to_year,
    valid_to_year - valid_from_year + 1 as franchise_identity_duration_years

with selections as (
    select *
    from BASKETBALL_DEV.staging.stg_draft_history
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by player_id, draft_year, draft_round, round_pick
        order by (overall_pick is not null) desc
    ) = 1
)
select
    s.*,
    coalesce(p.full_name, s.player_name) as canonical_player_name,
    coalesce(t.team_full_name, s.team_name) as canonical_team_name
from selections as s
left join BASKETBALL_DEV.staging.stg_player as p
    on s.player_id = p.player_id
left join BASKETBALL_DEV.staging.stg_team as t

with players as (
    select *
    from BASKETBALL_DEV.staging.stg_player
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by player_id
        order by (full_name is not null) desc
    ) = 1
),
player_profiles as (
    select *
    from BASKETBALL_DEV.staging.stg_common_player_info
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by player_id
        order by (birth_date is not null) desc,
                 (display_name is not null) desc
    ) = 1
),
draft_players as (
    select
        player_id,
        max(player_name) as player_name
    from BASKETBALL_DEV.staging.stg_draft_history
    group by player_id
),
combine_players as (
    select
        player_id,
        max(player_name) as player_name
    from BASKETBALL_DEV.staging.stg_draft_combine_stats
    group by player_id
),
inactive_players as (
    select
        player_id,
        max(nullif(trim(concat_ws(' ', first_name, last_name)), '')) as player_name
    from BASKETBALL_DEV.staging.stg_inactive_players
    group by player_id
),
player_ids as (
    select player_id from players
    union
    select player_id from player_profiles
    union
    select player_id from draft_players
    union
    select player_id from combine_players
    union
    select player_id from inactive_players
)
select
    md5('NBA_PLAYER:' || ids.player_id) as player_key,
    ids.player_id,
    coalesce(p.full_name, cp.display_name, dp.player_name, c.player_name, i.player_name) as player_name,
    coalesce(p.first_name, cp.first_name) as first_name,
    coalesce(p.last_name, cp.last_name) as last_name,
    cp.birth_date,
    cp.school,
    cp.country,
    cp.height,
    cp.weight_lbs,
    cp.position,
    cp.seasons_experience,
    cp.draft_year,
    cp.draft_round,
    cp.draft_pick_number,
    cp.is_nba_75_player,
    coalesce(p.is_active, false) as is_active
from player_ids as ids
left join players as p using (player_id)
left join player_profiles as cp using (player_id)
left join draft_players as dp using (player_id)
left join combine_players as c using (player_id)
left join inactive_players as i using (player_id)

    md5('NBA_PLAYER:' || player_id) as player_key,

from BASKETBALL_DEV.intermediate.int_draft_combine

with teams as (
    select *
    from BASKETBALL_DEV.staging.stg_team
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by team_id
        order by (team_full_name is not null) desc
    ) = 1
),
game_teams as (
    select home_team_id as team_id, home_team_name as team_full_name,
           home_team_abbreviation as team_abbreviation, null::varchar as team_city
    from BASKETBALL_DEV.staging.stg_game
    union
    select away_team_id as team_id, away_team_name as team_full_name,
           away_team_abbreviation as team_abbreviation, null::varchar as team_city
    from BASKETBALL_DEV.staging.stg_game
    union
    select team_id, team_name as team_full_name, team_abbreviation, team_city
    from BASKETBALL_DEV.staging.stg_draft_history
    where team_id is not null
    union
    select team_id, null::varchar as team_full_name, null::varchar as team_abbreviation,
           team_city
    from BASKETBALL_DEV.staging.stg_team_history
    union
    select team_id, team_name as team_full_name, team_abbreviation, team_city
    from BASKETBALL_DEV.staging.stg_inactive_players
    where team_id is not null
),
all_teams as (
    select team_id, team_full_name, team_abbreviation, team_nickname,
           team_city, team_state, year_founded
    from teams
    union all
    select g.team_id, g.team_full_name, g.team_abbreviation, null, g.team_city,
           null, null
    from game_teams as g
    where not exists (
        select 1 from teams as t where t.team_id = g.team_id
    )
),
deduplicated_teams as (
    select *
    from all_teams
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by team_id
        order by (team_full_name is not null) desc,
                 (team_abbreviation is not null) desc
    ) = 1
),
details as (
    select *
    from BASKETBALL_DEV.staging.stg_team_details
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by team_id
        order by (arena is not null) desc
    ) = 1
)
select
    md5('NBA_TEAM:' || cast(t.team_id as varchar)) as team_key,
    t.team_id,
    t.team_full_name,
    t.team_abbreviation,
    t.team_nickname,
    t.team_city,
    t.team_state,
    t.year_founded,
    d.arena,
    d.arena_capacity,
    d.owner_name,
    d.general_manager,
    d.head_coach,
    d.g_league_affiliation
from deduplicated_teams as t
left join details as d using (team_id)

line_score as (

other_stats as (

    g.home_blocks,
    g.home_turnovers,
    g.home_personal_fouls,
    g.home_plus_minus,
    g.away_field_goals_made,
    g.away_field_goals_attempted,
    g.away_field_goal_pct,
    g.away_three_pointers_made,
    g.away_three_pointers_attempted,
    g.away_three_point_pct,
    g.away_free_throws_made,
    g.away_free_throws_attempted,
    g.away_free_throw_pct,
    g.away_offensive_rebounds,
    g.away_defensive_rebounds,
    g.away_rebounds,
    g.away_assists,
    g.away_steals,
    g.away_blocks,
    g.away_turnovers,
    g.away_personal_fouls,
    g.away_plus_minus,
    gi.attendance,
    gi.game_duration,
    os.home_points_in_paint,
    os.home_second_chance_points,
    os.home_fast_break_points,
    os.home_largest_lead,
    os.home_team_turnovers,
    os.home_total_turnovers,
    os.home_team_rebounds,
    os.home_points_off_turnovers,
    os.away_points_in_paint,
    os.away_second_chance_points,
    os.away_fast_break_points,
    os.away_largest_lead,
    os.away_team_turnovers,
    os.away_total_turnovers,
    os.away_team_rebounds,
    os.away_points_off_turnovers,
    os.lead_changes,

from BASKETBALL_DEV.staging.stg_game as g
left join game_info as gi using (game_id)

where g.home_team_id is not null
  and g.away_team_id is not null

select
    md5(
        'NBA_DRAFT:' || coalesce(player_id, '') || ':' ||
        coalesce(cast(draft_year as varchar), '') || ':' ||
        coalesce(cast(draft_round as varchar), '') || ':' ||
        coalesce(cast(round_pick as varchar), '')
    ) as draft_selection_key,
    player_id,
    md5('NBA_PLAYER:' || player_id) as player_key,
    team_id,
    case when team_id is not null
        then md5('NBA_TEAM:' || cast(team_id as varchar))
        else null
    end as team_key,
    draft_year,
    draft_round,
    round_pick,
    overall_pick,
    draft_type,
    canonical_player_name as player_name,
    canonical_team_name as team_name,
    organization,
    organization_type,
    overall_pick = 1 as is_first_overall_pick,
    draft_round = 1 as is_first_round,
    case when overall_pick between 1 and 14 then true else false end as is_lottery_pick,
    case when overall_pick between 1 and 10 then true else false end as is_top_10_pick
from BASKETBALL_DEV.intermediate.int_draft_selections

select distinct
    md5(
        'NBA_SEASON:' || cast(season_id as varchar) || ':' ||
        coalesce(season_type, '')
    ) as season_key,
    season_id,
    season_year,
    case
        when season_year is not null
            then cast(season_year as varchar) || '-' ||
                 right(cast(season_year + 1 as varchar), 2)
        else null
    end as season_label,
    season_type
from BASKETBALL_DEV.intermediate.int_game_enriched
where season_id is not null

with bounds as (

    select
        min(game_date) as min_date,
        max(game_date) as max_date
    from BASKETBALL_DEV.intermediate.int_game_enriched

),

calendar as (

    select
        dateadd(
            day,
            seq4(),
            min_date
        ) as full_date
    from bounds,
    table(
        generator(
            rowcount => 50000
        )
    )
    where dateadd(
        day,
        seq4(),
        min_date
    ) <= max_date

)

select
    to_number(to_char(full_date, 'YYYYMMDD')) as date_key,
    full_date,

    year(full_date) as calendar_year,
    quarter(full_date) as calendar_quarter,
    month(full_date) as month_number,

    monthname(full_date) as month_name,

    day(full_date) as day_of_month,

    dayofweek(full_date) as day_of_week_number,

    dayname(full_date) as day_name,

    weekofyear(full_date) as week_of_year,

    case
        when dayofweek(full_date) in (0, 6)
        then true
        else false
    end as is_weekend

from calendar

select
    md5(game_id || ':' || player_id) as inactive_player_key,
    game_id,
    player_id,

    md5('NBA_PLAYER:' || player_id) as player_key,

    team_id,

    case
        when team_id is not null
            then md5('NBA_TEAM:' || cast(team_id as varchar))
        else null
    end as team_key,

    first_name,
    last_name,
    jersey_number,
    team_abbreviation,

    to_number(
        to_char(g.game_date, 'YYYYMMDD')
    ) as date_key,

    md5(
        'NBA_SEASON:' || cast(g.season_id as varchar) || ':' ||
        coalesce(g.season_type, '')
    ) as season_key

from BASKETBALL_DEV.intermediate.int_inactive_player_appearances as i
left join BASKETBALL_DEV.intermediate.int_game_enriched as g
    using (game_id)

select
    md5(a.game_id || ':' || a.official_id) as game_official_key,

    a.game_id,
    a.official_id,

    md5('NBA_OFFICIAL:' || a.official_id) as official_key,

    to_number(
        to_char(g.game_date, 'YYYYMMDD')
    ) as date_key,

    md5(
        'NBA_SEASON:' || cast(g.season_id as varchar) || ':' ||
        coalesce(g.season_type, '')
    ) as season_key

from BASKETBALL_DEV.intermediate.int_game_official_assignments as a
left join BASKETBALL_DEV.intermediate.int_game_enriched as g

),
home_team_games as (

away_team_games as (

        season_id,

        'AWAY' as team_role,

        away_free_throws_made as free_throws_made,
        away_free_throws_attempted as free_throws_attempted,
        away_free_throw_pct as free_throw_pct,
        away_offensive_rebounds as offensive_rebounds,
        away_defensive_rebounds as defensive_rebounds,
        away_rebounds as rebounds,
        away_assists as assists,
        away_steals as steals,
        away_blocks as blocks,
        away_turnovers as turnovers,
        away_personal_fouls as personal_fouls,
        away_points_in_paint as points_in_paint,
        away_second_chance_points as second_chance_points,
        away_fast_break_points as fast_break_points,
        away_points_off_turnovers as points_off_turnovers,
        attendance,

        lead_changes,
        times_tied
    from games
)
select * from home_team_games
union all
select * from away_team_games

select
    md5(cast(g.game_id as varchar) || ':' || cast(g.team_id as varchar)) as team_game_key,
    g.game_id,

    to_number(to_char(g.game_date, 'YYYYMMDD')) as date_key,

    md5(
        'NBA_SEASON:' || cast(g.season_id as varchar) || ':' ||
        coalesce(g.season_type, '')
    ) as season_key,

    md5('NBA_TEAM:' || cast(g.team_id as varchar)) as team_key,
    md5('NBA_TEAM:' || cast(g.opponent_team_id as varchar)) as opponent_team_key,

    g.team_id,
    g.opponent_team_id,
    g.team_role,
    g.season_id,
    g.season_year,
    g.season_type,
    g.is_win,

    g.points,
    g.opponent_points,
    g.points - g.opponent_points as point_differential,

    g.field_goals_made,
    g.field_goals_attempted,
    g.field_goal_pct,

    g.three_pointers_made,
    g.three_pointers_attempted,
    g.three_point_pct,

    g.free_throws_made,
    g.free_throws_attempted,
    g.free_throw_pct,

    g.offensive_rebounds,
    g.defensive_rebounds,
    g.rebounds,
    g.assists,
    g.steals,
    g.blocks,
    g.turnovers,
    g.personal_fouls,

    g.points_in_paint,
    g.second_chance_points,
    g.fast_break_points,
    g.points_off_turnovers,

    g.attendance,
    g.game_minutes,
    g.lead_changes,
    g.times_tied

from BASKETBALL_DEV.intermediate.int_team_game_stats as g
where g.game_date is not null

select
    md5(e.game_id || ':' || cast(e.event_number as varchar)) as play_key,

    e.game_id,
    e.event_number,

    to_number(
        to_char(g.game_date, 'YYYYMMDD')
    ) as date_key,

    md5(
        'NBA_SEASON:' || cast(g.season_id as varchar) || ':' ||
        coalesce(g.season_type, '')
    ) as season_key,

    e.event_type_id,
    e.event_action_type_id,
    e.event_category,

    e.period_number,
    e.game_clock,
    e.period_clock,

    e.home_description,
    e.neutral_description,
    e.away_description,

    e.score_text,
    e.score_margin,

    e.player1_id,
    md5('NBA_PLAYER:' || e.player1_id) as player1_key,
    e.player1_name,
    e.player1_team_id,

    case
        when e.player1_team_id is not null
            then md5('NBA_TEAM:' || cast(e.player1_team_id as varchar))
        else null
    end as player1_team_key,

    e.player2_id,
    md5('NBA_PLAYER:' || e.player2_id) as player2_key,
    e.player2_name,
    e.player2_team_id,

    e.player3_id,
    md5('NBA_PLAYER:' || e.player3_id) as player3_key,
    e.player3_name,
    e.player3_team_id,

    e.video_available

from BASKETBALL_DEV.intermediate.int_play_by_play as e
left join BASKETBALL_DEV.intermediate.int_game_enriched as g
    using (game_id)
